digest.en: UK petrol prices rise to highest this year as US attacks Iran, prompting concerns about global oil supply and economic instability. Meanwhile, India-based sales agent of Iran's Mahan Air faces US sanctions, further straining already tense relations between the two nations. In a separate development, Ukraine hits Russian logistics hubs, escalating the conflict in eastern Europe.
